goal: Make claim-version supersession accept established unambiguous claim-title forms and name the exact identity field that changed.
prohibited_actions: Do not change database structure or data, relax exact-issue binding, or mutate live claims during verification.
assumptions: Claim titles beginning CLAIM: followed by a bare number or optional Issue token are established forms and remain unambiguous only when normalized to one exact workstream.
stop_conditions: Stop if accepting an established title form weakens exact issue identity or compound-workstream parsing.
